南边坡下，一串白影子在往上走。光着脚，不出一点声音。: Down the southern slope, a string of white shapes is climbing. Barefoot, without a sound.
潮水从营地中间漫过去了。天亮的时候点人，粮棚前那个数麻袋的兵不见了。: The tide flowed right through the camp. At dawn they counted heads: the soldier who tallied sacks by the grain shed was gone.
最后一个白影子翻过了北边的山脊。营地里的火都还亮着，人一个没少。天快亮了。: The last white shape crests the northern ridge. Every fire in camp still burns and no one is missing. Dawn is close.

天黑透了。三辆粮车点着火把出了村，上了盘山路。马蒂亚斯的六个人举着火把走在车两边: Full dark. Three grain carts leave the village by torchlight onto the mountain road. Matthias's six walk beside them with torches; Anselm's cart guards follow behind.
天亮了。山脊上，第十九烽的火还亮着。: Dawn. On the ridge, the Nineteenth Beacon still burns.
天亮了。山脊上，第十九烽的塔顶没有烟。: Dawn. On the ridge, no smoke rises from the Nineteenth Beacon.
冰原上那口石井边，站着一圈人。光着脚，闭着眼，一动不动——脸都朝着井。: By the stone well on the ice field stands a ring of people. Barefoot, eyes closed, unmoving, every face turned toward the well.
诺伯特从天窗下去了：「翻过山脊，往冰原那边。我在那儿等你。」: Norbert drops down through the hatch: "Over the ridge, toward the ice field. I'll wait for you there."
（钟声从钟楼上落下来，一下，又一下。隔着那扇高窗，看得见平原上的雪亮了）: (The bell tolls down from the tower, once, and again. Through the high window, the snow on the plain grows bright.)
（最后一滴血落进誓瓶。冰壁上那一大片空着的冰里，慢慢浮出一个名字。井口上那一圈人: (The last drop of blood falls into the oath vial. In the wide blank stretch of the ice wall, a name slowly surfaces. The ring at the well's mouth stops, and one by one they turn and walk south.)
（火盆一个接一个暗下去。那一圈人从石阶上走下来，围住了石台。誓瓶还是空的）: (One by one the braziers gutter out. The ring comes down the stone steps and closes around the altar. The oath vial is still empty.)
（钟楼上的黄昏钟响了。一下，又一下。高窗外，冠城的屋顶一片一片暗下去）: (The evening bell rings in the tower, once, and again. Beyond the high window, the roofs of the Crown City darken one by one.)
（诺伯特在你身边站住了，很久没说话）……三十五年，我头一回走到这口井边。它们没往: (Norbert stops beside you and says nothing for a long while.) … Thirty-five years, and this is the first time I've come to this well. They don't go north. They stand here, faces to the well, as if they're waiting for something.
天黑了。营里把最后几捆柴省着烧，火盆里的火压得很小。没有人说话。: Night falls. The camp eats into its last bundles of firewood; the braziers are banked low. No one speaks.
爬上山脊的时候，天已经擦黑了。: By the time you reach the ridge, dusk has fallen.
